senses.gloss:
शु 1. शु, a form assumed by rt. श्वि, cf.
rt. शव्.

शु 2. शु, ind. (perhaps connected with सु or
with आशु), well, right, brilliantly, elegantly; quickly
(= क्षिप्रम्, Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 33, 1).
2. षु, उस्, m. child-bearing, parturition, delivery.

षू, ऊस्, f. (= 4. सू, q. v.), child-bearing, delivery,
birth.

सु 1. सु, cl. 1. P. A. सवति, सवते, &c.,
to go.

सु 2. सु, cl. 1. 2. P. सवति, सौति, सुषाव,
&c., to possess power or supremacy.

सु 3. सु, cl. 5. P. A. सुनोति (1st du. सु-
नुवस् or सुन्वस्, 1st pl. सुनुमस् or सुन्-
मस्), सुनुते, सुषाव, सुषुवे, सोष्यति, -ते,
असावीत् or असौषीत्, असोष्ट or असविष्ट, सोतुम्
(Ved. Inf. सोतवे), to pour out, sprinkle, make a
libation (especially of the Soma juice); to press out
juice (especially from the Soma plant), to extract
or prepare the Soma juice or any other juice, to
distil (wine, spirits, &c.); to churn; to perform a
sacrifice (especially with the Soma); to bathe [cf.
1. सवन, सूत्या]: Pass. सूयते, Aor. असावि (Ved.
Pass. 3rd sing. सुन्वे, 3rd pl. सुन्विरे = सुता ब-
भूवुः): Caus. सावयति, -यितुम्, Aor. असूष-
वत् (according to some असीषवत्): Desid. of Caus.
सुषावयिषति: Desid. सुसूषति: Intens. सोषू-
यते; [cf. Gr. ὕ-ω, ὑ-ε-τό-ς; Umbr. savitu.]

सु 4. सु (= rt. 3. सू, p. 1130, but by
some identified with rt. 3. सु, col. 2, the
act of pouring out the Soma juice being compared
to that of generation); cl. 1. 2. P. सवति, सौति,
सुषाव, सोष्यति, असौषीत् or (according to some)
असावीत्, cl. 2. A. सूते (1st sing. सुवे), Impf. असूत
(1st sing. असुवि, 1st du. असूवहि), Pot. सुवीत,
[]
Impv. सूताम् (1st sing. सुवै, 1st du. सुवावहै,
1st pl. सुवामहै), cl. 4. A. सूयते, सुषुवे,
सोष्यते or सविष्यते, असोष्ट or असविष्ट, (in
Atharva-veda XIV. 1, 33. the form सुवाति occurs,
which might also be referred to rt. 1. सू), Inf. सोतुम्,
सवितुम्, to beget, procreate, engender, generate; to
bring forth a child, give birth to, bear, produce, yield;
to confer, bestow (Ved.); to gain, acquire (Ved.); to ac-
cept, (Sāy. साविषत् = अनुजानातु, Ṛg-veda I. 164,
26): Pass. सूयते, Aor. असावि, to be begotten; to be
brought forth: Caus. सावयति, -यितुम्, Aor. असू-
षवत्, (according to some असीषवत्): Desid. of
Caus. सुषावयिषति: Desid. सुसूषति, -ते: In-
tens. सोषूयते, सोषवीति, सोषोति; [cf. Zend
hunu, ‘a son;’ Gr. υἱός, ὑατέρα = Lat. uterus; Goth.
su-nu-s; Slav. sy-nu; Lith. su-nu-s, ‘a son.’]

सु 5. सु, ind. (thought by some to be a
shortened form of वसु, q. v.; opposed to
दुस्, q. v., and corresponding to Gr. εὖ; in the Veda
liable to become षु, see Ṛg-veda I. 36, 13, I. 112,
1, Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 107; and to lengthen a preceding
vowel, see Pāṇ. VI. 3, 134; also becoming सू in
Ṛg-veda I. 10, 11, &c.; cf. सुकम्), an enhancing
particle frequently used as a prefix implying ‘good,
well, excellent, excellently, beautiful, beautifully,
honourable, worthy of respect or reverence, excessive,
excessively, exceedingly, much, very; readily, easily,
willingly, quickly’ (Ved., Sāy. = सुष्ठु, and in
Ṛg-veda I. 112, 1, &c. used separately to qualify a
verb); according to native authorities this prefix may
also imply अनु-मति, ‘assent;’ सम्-ऋद्धि, ‘pros-
perity;’ कृच्छ्र, ‘distress;’ [cf. Gr. εὖ: Cambro-
Brit. hu, hy, he: Armor. he: Hib. so, soailce, ‘a
good fashion, good manners;’ sucridh, ‘easy,’ = सु-
कृत.]
—सु-ऊति, इस्, f., Ved. good protection, kind
assistance or favour.
—सु-कक्ष, अस्, m., N. of the
author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 81, 82 (having
the patronymic Āṅgirasa).
—सु-कण्टका, f. ‘hav-
ing good thorns,’ the Aloe plant, Aloe Indica.
—सु-
कण्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a musician.
—सु-कण्डु, उस्,
m. ‘much-scratching,’ the itch.
—सु-कन्द, अस्, m.
‘having a good bulb,’ an onion; a yam; the esculent
root Arum Campanulatum; a sort of grass, Scirpus
Kysoor; other bulbous plants (= वाराही-कन्द; =
धरणी-कन्द).
—सु-कन्दक, अस्, m. an onion.
—सु-कन्दिन्, ई, m. Arum Campanulatum.
—सु-
कन्यक or सु-कन्याक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
beautiful maiden, (Vopa-deva VII. 23.)
—सु-कन्या,
f. a beautiful girl; N. of a daughter of Śaryāti (and
wife of the Ṛṣi Cyavana).
—सु-कपर्द, अस्, आ,
अम्, having beautiful braided hair.
—सु-कर, अस्, आ,
or ई, अम्, easy to be done, practicable, feasible,
attainable; easy to be managed, doing well; (आ), f.
a tractable cow; (अम्), n. doing good, charity, be-
nevolence.
—सुकर-सन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, easily joined
or united.
—सु-कर्णक, अस्, इका, अम्, having
beautiful ears; (अस्), m. a particular tree, = हस्ति-
कन्द; (इका), f. the plant Salvinia Cucullata.
—सु-
कर्णी, f. the colocynth.
—सु-कर्म, आस्, m. pl.,
N. of a class of deities.
—सु-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, one
whose deeds are righteous or virtuous, performing
good works; doing what is right, acting virtuously,
virtuous, good; active, diligent; (आ), m. epithet of
Viśva-karman (the artist or architect of the gods);
the seventh of the twenty-seven astronomical Yogas,
(see योग); N. of a teacher of the Sāma-veda;
(आणस्), m. pl., N. of a class of deities.
—सु-कल,
अस्, आ, अम्, (said to be fr. rt. 1. कल्, to sound forth),
one who has a great reputation for liberality both
in giving and using.
—सु-कवि, इस्, m. a good or
excellent poet.
—सुकवि-ता, f. the state of a good
poet, excellent poetical talent.
—सु-काण्ड, अस्, आ,
अम्, having a good stem or stalk; well-jointed;
(अस्), m. the Kāravella plant.
—सु-काण्डिका, f. the
Kāṇḍīra creeper.
—सु-काण्डिन्, having good stems
[]
or stalks; beautifully jointed; (ई), m. a bee.
—सु-
कान्ति, इस्, m., N. of a son of Pulaha.
—सु-काम,
अस्, आ, अम्, having good desires; (आ), f. the Trāya-
māṇā plant.
—सु-कालिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a class
of Pitṛs (regarded as the sons of Vasiṣṭha and
the especial Pitṛs of Śūdras).
—सु-कालुका, f. the
Ḍoḍī shrub.
—सु-काष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having good
wood; (आ), f. the Kaṭvī plant, the Kāṣṭha-kadalī,
q. v.
—सु-काष्ठक, अस्, आ, अम्, having good
wood; (अम्), n. the Deva-dāru pine.
—सु-किं-
शुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having beautiful Kiṃśuka
wood (said of a carriage either from being made of
this wood or from resembling in colour the flowers
of the Kiṃśuka tree, Ṛg-veda X. 85, 20; perhaps
to be translated ‘bright-coloured’).
—सु-कीर्त्ति, इस्,
f. good report, celebration; epithet of a particular
hymn; (इस्), m., N. of the author of Ṛg-veda X.
131 (having the patronymic Kākṣīvata).
—सु-कुच,
अस्, आ, अम्, handsome-breasted, having beautiful breasts.
—सु-कुन्दक, अस्, m. an onion; [cf. सु-कन्दक.]
—सु-कुन्दन, अस्, m. the Varvara plant.
—सु-
कुमार, अस्, m. a beautiful youth; (अस्, आ or ई, अम्),
beautifully young or youthful, very soft or tender,
delicate, smooth; (अस्), m. a variety of the sugar-
cane (= पुण्ड्र); the Śyāmāka grain; a sort of
mustard (= क्षव); the wild Campaka; N. of a
Daitya; of the father of Satya-ketu; (आ), f. double
jasmine; great-flowered jasmine; the plantain; another
plant (= पृक्का); N. of a river; (ई), f. the Nava-
mālikā jasmine.
—सु-कुमारक, अस्, m. a beautiful
youth; rice, = शालि; (अम्), n. the Tamāla-pattra,
q. v.
—सुकुमार-तनु-त्वच्, क्, क्, क्, having very
soft and delicate skin.
—सुकुमार-तर, अस्, आ,
अम्, much more delicate.
—सुकुमार-नख-त्वच्,
क्, क्, क्, having very delicate nails and skin.
—सुकु-
माराङ्ग (˚र-अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having very soft
limbs.
—सु-कुरीर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a beau-
tiful head-dress.
—सु-कुल, अम्, n. a good or virtuous
family; (अस्, आ, अम्), of good family; well-born.
—सु-कुल-स्त्री, ईस्, f. a woman of good family, a
respectable woman.
—सु-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, doing good,
benevolent; virtuous, pious; wise, learned; fortunate,
well-fated; performing splendid sacrifices, making
good offerings; (त्), m. a skilful worker, epithet of
Tvaṣṭṛ.
—सु-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done well or pro-
perly; well made, well constructed; treated with
kindness, befriended, assisted; virtuous, pious; for-
tunate, auspicious; (अम्), n. any good or virtuous
act, kindness, bounty, friendliness, aid; virtue, moral
merit; fortune, auspiciousness; reward, recompense.
—सुकृतावास (˚त-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, constituting a
well-made residence, well provided with accommoda-
tion.
—सु-कृति, इस्, f. well-doing; acting in a friendly
or kind manner, kindness; virtue; the practice of
religious austerities; (इस्), m., N. of a son of Pṛthu.
—सु-कृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, acting well or kindly; vir-
tuous, pious, good; benevolent; wise, learned;
fortunate, lucky.
—सुकृतोच्छ्रय (˚त-उच्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, made very high, very lofty.
—सुकृतोदीरण
(˚त-उद्˚), अम्, n. the proclaiming or blazoning
abroad of good actions.
—सुकृत्-तर, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. more beneficent.
—सु-कृत्या, f., Ved. good
sacrificing, a splendid sacrificial offering.
—सु-केतु,
उस्, m., N. of a son of Nandi-vardhana; of a son
of Su-nītha.
—सु-केश, अस्, आ, or ई (Pāṇ. IV. 1, 54),
अम्, having beautiful hair; (अस्), m., N. of a son of
Vidyut-keśa; (ई), f., N. of an Apsaras.
—सु-केशन्,
m. (apparently) a proper N. (in conjunction with
Bhāradvāja).
—सु-केशर or सु-केसर, अस्, m. the
citron; (अम्), n. a kind of metre.
—सुकेशान्त
(˚श-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having beautiful locks of hair
or ringlets.
—सु-केशि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Vidyut-
keśin.
—सु-केशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, = सु-केश; (ई), m. =
सु-केशि.
—सु-कोली, f. a medicinal root (= क्षीर-
काकोली).
—सु-कोशक, अस्, m. the Kośāmra plant.
—सु-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. well-sacrificing, doing
good acts or very wise, (Sāy. = शोभन-कर्मन् or
शोभन-प्रज्ञ); (उस्), m. an epithet of Agni;
of Mitra and Varuṇa; of Savitṛ; of Soma; of
Indra.
—सुक्रतूयया, ind. from a desire to sacrifice
well or to do good, (Sāy. शोभन-कर्मेच्छया,
[]
Ṛg-veda I. 160, 4.)
—सु-क्रिया, f. a good action,
good work, moral or religious observance.
—सु-
क्रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, very angry.
—सु-क्षत्र,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a good dominion, mighty,
strong, powerful; (अस्), m., N. of a king.
—सु-
क्षय, अस्, m. a beautiful house, (Sāy. = शोभन
यज्ञ-गृह, Ṛg-veda X. 23, 4.)
—सु-क्षिति, इस्,
इस्, इ, Ved. having good dwellings, granting good
dwellings.
—सु-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. an excellent field.
—सु-क्षेत्रिया, ind., Ved. desire for good fields or
with such desire, (Sāy. = सुक्षेत्रेच्छा, Ṛg-veda
I. 97, 2; cf. सु-गातुया.)
—सु-क्षेमन्, अ, n.,
Ved. water, (in Naigh. I. 12. enumerated among
the उदक-नामानि.)
—सु-ख, &c., see सुख,
s. v.
—सु-खादि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. wearing beautiful
rings (said of the Maruts; cf. खादि-हस्त).
—सु-
ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, very renowned, celebrated,
famous.
—सु-ख्याति, इस्, f. good report, fame, cele-
brity.
—सु-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going well or gracefully,
graceful, elegant; easy of access, easily passed, (op-
posed to दुर्-ग); easily understood, intelligible;
(अम्), n. happiness; feces, ordure.
—सु-गण्, ण्, ण्,
ण्, counting well or easily, a ready reckoner; easily
calculated.
—सु-गणित, अस्, आ, अम्, easily or accu-
rately calculated.
—सु-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, well-gone,
going well, passed, gone; well-bestowed; (अस्), m.
the Buddha or a particular Buddha.
—सु-गति, इस्, m.
a good or happy condition; N. of an Arhat.
—सु-
गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, sweet-smelling, odoriferous,
fragrant; (अस्), m. fragrance, odour, perfume; sul-
phur; the red Śigru tree; = चणक; = भू-तृन;
a trader, dealer; (आ), f. the ichneumon plant (=
रास्ना); zedoary, Curcuma Zerumbet; a fragrant
grass; a sort of lime; sacred basil; various plants
and trees (including several kinds of jasmine, =
बन्ध्या-कर्कोटकी; = रुद्र-जटा; = शत-पुष्-
पा; = नाकुली; नव-मालिका; स्वर्ण-यूथिका;
पृक्का; गङ्गा-पत्त्री; सल्लकी; माधवी;
अनन्ता; मातुलुङ्गा); N. of a goddess; of an
Apsaras; (अम्), n. small cumin seed; a fragrant
grass (= कत्-तृण, p. 199); the blue lotus; sandal;
the Granthi-parṇa plant.
—सुगन्धक, अस्, m. the
red Tulasī; sulphur; the orange; a sort of gourd,
Momordica Mixta.
—सुगन्ध-ता, f. fragrance,
perfume.
—सुगन्ध-तैल-निर्यास, अम्, n. a par-
ticular perfume made with roses, &c.
—सुगन्ध-
पत्त्रा, f. the plant Rudra-jaṭā.
—सुगन्ध-भू-
तृण, अम्, n. a kind of fragrant grass.
—सुगन्ध-
मूला, f. ‘having a fragrant root,’ the ichneumon
plant (= स्थल-पद्मिनी).
—सुगन्धादित्य (˚ध-
आद्˚), अस्, m. a proper N.
—सुगन्धामलक
(˚ध-आम्˚), अम्, n. a kind of mixture of various
herbs.
—सु-गन्धार, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva.
—सु-गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, very sweet-smelling or
fragrant, redolent with perfumes; virtuous, pious;
(इस्), m. a perfume, fragrance; the supreme Being
(= परमात्मन्); a sort of sweet-smelling Mango;
(इ), n. a drug and perfume (= एलबालुक); the
root of long pepper; a kind of fragrant grass (both
Cyperus Rotundus and Scirpus Kysoor); coriander
seed (= गन्ध-तृण; = पिप्पली-मूल).
—सु-
गन्धिक, अस्, m. ‘having a sweet or strong smell,’
incense; sulphur; a sort of large rice; (अम्), n. the
white lotus (= पुष्कर-मूल; = गौर-सुवर्ण;
= उशीर).
—सुगन्धि-कुसुम, अम्, n. a fragrant
flower; (अस्), m. a sort of yellow oleander; (आ), f.
the plant Trigonella Corniculata.
—सुगन्धि-ता,
f. fragrance, agreeable scent, perfume.
—सुगन्धि-
तेजन, Ved. a kind of fragrant grass.
—सुगन्धि-
त्रिफला, f. nutmeg; areca nut; cloves.
—सु-गन्-
धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, very fragrant or sweet-smelling;
(इनी), f. the fragrant plant Ārāma-śītalā.
—सुगन्-
धि-मूल, अम्, n. the root of Uśīra; (आ), f. the

—सुगन्धेश (˚धा-ईश), अस्, m. a
statue of the tutelary deity of Su-gandhā.
—सु-गन्-
मन्, see Vopa-deva XXVI. 68.
—सु-गभस्ति, इस्,
इस्, इ, Ved. beautiful-handed, skilful-handed (said of
Tvaṣṭṛ).
—सु-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, easy to be tra-
versed or travelled over, easy of access or approach,
accessible; easy, practicable; plain, intelligible; [cf.
[]
दुर्-गम.]
—सु-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = सु-गम,
col. 1.
—सु-गव or सु-गव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
having fine cows, abounding in cattle.
—सु-गहन,
अस्, आ, अम्, very thick or close, very impervious;
(आ), f. an enclosure round a place of sacrifice to

—सुगहना-
वृति (˚न-आव्˚), इस्, f. a sacred enclosure, (see above.)

इस्, f. good protection, secrecy.

-करोति, -कर्तुम्, to guard well.
